name: happlied-extension
description: happlied - Personal Job Application Assistant & Career Copilot Chrome Extension

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts
scripts.package: npm run build && powershell -Command "$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; Compress-Archive -Path dist/* -DestinationPath happlied.zip -Force; Copy-Item happlied.zip happlymate.zip -Force; Copy-Item happlied.zip applymate.zip -Force"
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run build && node ./scripts/verifyRelease.js
